purpose: Evidence-backed school names for the campus base-building index. Identity matches are spatial research findings, not surveyed individual floor plans or native Minecraft acceptance.
centroid_method: Polygon area centroid computed in EPSG:6347 from the unmodified local county footprint, then transformed to EPSG:4326. Decimal precision does not indicate survey accuracy.
join_key: roofer_parent_id is the unique local footprint key. county_structure_id alone is not unique and must not be used to merge different campus footprints.
verified_status_meaning: Current official school map and earlier explicit facilities plan agree on location, outline/adjoining landmarks and identity when compared with georeferenced county geometry over the cached 2021 PEMA orthophoto. Whole-outline status identifies the source footprint; it does not certify every minor roof projection or current use of every room.

limitations: No Chrome/Google Maps interaction was performed by this research agent. Google building-ring cross-check remains a separate root-agent review.
County labels and numbering are not school map labels; duplicates and stale assessment uses exist.
Athey and Dining share one source parent, as do Mercer/squash and Sweeney. Do not use the aggregate centroid as an asserted named-part center, and do not stamp one facade over the entire aggregate.
This index intentionally omits unverified names and exact splits. It may be expanded after additional evidence.

Expanded2026 named-building coverage is36map groups across42unique county parents. Kipp Pavilion19 and Madden26press-box geometry remain explicit limitations. This is identity/footprint coverage, not a claim that all current campus structures or facades have been modeled.
